description: How did this crypto-X account's calls do? Send one account's tweets (with created_at): we find every token it pushed (contract addresses, token links, cashtags) and answer from our records of new pools on six chains since 2026-10-22: risk score when we first saw the pool, whether liquidity was gone at 24h, 48h, 7d and 30d, and how early the call came. Summary: lost vs kept. Scores committed daily. No X access. Not advice. Costs $0.03 USDC on Base via x402.
